description: stablenet: 4 bp, with governance proposals expiring in 30 seconds instead of the template's 604800. A case that watches a proposal expire cannot wait seven days, so the genesis is what makes the expiry observable — and what declares the short-expiry capability. Used by 1 case (the burn-refund one also needs boho, so it takes stablenet-bp4-boho-short-expiry).
